# ANTIGRAVITY EXECUTIVE DIRECTIVE — DIR-095
## Candidate Dashboard Streamlining (Resume Slider Removal), 100% Operational Sidebar Navigation, and Native Multi-Device Responsiveness

**Standard ID:** AEDS-001  
**Target Project:** IME365 — Interview Made Easy  
**Required Workspace:** `D:\xampp\htdocs\IME365`  
**Directive ID:** `DIR-095`  
**Priority:** P0 — Critical  
**Mode:** PLAN ONLY — Read-Only Investigation & Architectural Planning  
**Status:** ISSUED — Awaiting Architecture Plan & Visual Layout Blueprint  
**Execution Authority:** Inspection, architectural mapping, and plan submission only. Code implementation is strictly prohibited in this phase.

---

# SECTION 1 — EXECUTIVE MANDATE

Execute a high-impact architectural enhancement and UI/UX streamlining of the Candidate Dashboard (`https://ime365.local/dashboard`) and the complete Candidate Workspace navigation chrome:

1. **Dashboard Overview Streamlining (Removal of Redundant Resume Carousel)**:
   Per authoritative user directive and verified forensic evidence, the horizontal Resume Carousel and filtering toolbar currently mounted on `https://ime365.local/dashboard` (`DashboardHomepage.jsx`) is **NOT REQUIRED on the dashboard** and must be cleanly removed/suppressed.
   - Specifically remove/suppress:
     a) Real-Time Search & Category Folder Filter Tabs (`All Resumes (35)`, `Tailored (0)`, `Master (1)`, `Drafts (11)`), search input box, sort dropdown (`data-testid="cuba-resume-sort"`), and grid/list view mode toggle (`data-testid="cuba-resume-view-toggle"`).
     b) Horizontal Resume Slider / Grid Cards (`Recruiter Resume` cards, dashed `+ Create a New Resume` card, horizontal scroll track, and card action menus).
     c) Resume Pagination controls (`Page X of Y`).
   - Retain and cleanly elevate all essential candidate command and intelligence surfaces on `/dashboard`:
     a) Candidate Hero HUD (`CubaCandidateHero.jsx`): Welcome greeting, Quick Action pills (`Create with AI`, `Upload Resume`), and real measured KPI counters (`Total Resumes`, `Applications`, `Mock Interviews`, `Profile Completeness`).
     b) Contextual Next Best Action Card (`Next Best Action • ATS Score: X/100`): Dynamic guidance based on actual measured resume score (`topAtsScore`).
     c) Bottom 3-Column Analytics & Intelligence Band (`data-testid="cuba-candidate-analytics"`): Application Progress Chart, Top Job Matches, and Next Steps.
     d) Dockable Executive Copilot Rail (`CandidateExecutiveRail.jsx`) with toggle button.
   - Resumes remain fully authored, edited, cloned, and managed in the dedicated Resume Builder workspace (`/build-resume`), eliminating duplication and cognitive clutter on the Overview.

2. **100% Operational Sidebar Navigation**:
   Audit, verify, and guarantee that EVERY SINGLE option in the candidate sidebar navigation (all 15 authoritative destinations defined in `src/components/cuba/candidateNavigation.js`) is 100% operational and works perfectly:
   - **Workspace Group**:
     1. `Overview` (`/dashboard`): Renders streamlined executive overview.
     2. `Resumes & Master CV` (`/build-resume`): Launches Resume Builder workspace.
     3. `Cover Letters` (`/dashboard/cover-letters`): Mounts `CoverLetter.jsx`, create/edit/delete letters.
     4. `Portfolios & Web CV` (`/dashboard/portfolios`): Mounts `DashboardPortfolios.jsx`, project management.
     5. `Saved Favorites & Bookmarks` (`/dashboard/favorites`): Mounts `DashboardFavourites.jsx`, bookmarked jobs/resumes.
     6. `Notifications` (`/dashboard/notifications`): Mounts `DashboardNotifications.jsx`, notification center.
   - **Job Intelligence Group**:
     7. `Browse Job Portal` (`/dashboard/jobs`): Mounts `MainJobListings.jsx`, search, filter, apply.
     8. `Job Tracker` (`/dashboard/job-tracker`): Mounts `JobTracker.jsx`, Kanban stage board.
     9. `Submitted Applications` (`/dashboard/applied-jobs`): Mounts `AppliedJobs.jsx`, application history.
     10. `AI Interview Coach` (`/dashboard/interview`): Mounts `DashboardInterviews.jsx`, AI simulator.
     11. `Messages & Chat` (`/dashboard/messages`): Mounts `DashboardMessages.jsx`, active chat threads.
   - **Account & Security Group**:
     12. `Subscription & Plans` (`/dashboard/plans`): Mounts `Billing.jsx`, tier upgrades, Stripe modal.
     13. `Master Profile Data` (`/dashboard/settings?tab=Profile`): Mounts `DashboardSettings.jsx`, activates Profile tab.
     14. `Security & 2FA Hub` (`/dashboard/settings?tab=Security`): Mounts `DashboardSettings.jsx`, activates Security/TOTP hub.
     15. `Help Desk & Support` (`/dashboard/support`): Mounts `DashboardSupport.jsx`, tickets and FAQ.
   - Guarantee zero dead links, zero 404s, zero unhandled exceptions, zero stub click handlers, perfect active route highlight (`aria-current="page"`), and real-time reactive badge synchronization.

3. **Native Multi-Device Responsiveness (Zero Regressions Across All Viewports)**:
   Verify and guarantee flawless native-app alignment and responsiveness across all device breakpoints:
   - Mobile Small (320px - 375px): Native mobile sliding drawer with backdrop blur, tap-outside dismiss, escape dismiss; zero horizontal page overflow (`overflow-x: clip`); minimum 44px x 44px touch targets; single-column card stacking.
   - Mobile Large / Phablet (375px - 480px): Fluid spacing, responsive typography, natural touch ergonomics.
   - Tablet (768px - 1024px): Medium viewport reflow, 2-column analytics grid, icon-rail or drawer sidebar.
   - Desktop & Wide (1280px, 1440px, 1920px): Single-viewport bounded ergonomics (`xl:h-[calc(100dvh-var(--cuba-header-h)-3.75rem)]`), interior scrolling via `cuba-scrollbar`, zero whole-window scrolling on 1080p/1440p displays, fluid split-screen layout with collapsible Copilot rail.

# SECTION 7 — QUALITY, RESPONSIVENESS, ACCESSIBILITY, AND NON-FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS

3. **Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant)**:
